title: Update the quirks for pixart touchpad to be handled by the plugin. Also add patches to harden the update path. All of these are applied in subsequent fwupd releases.
description:
Update the quirks for pixart touchpad to be handled by the plugin. Also add patches to harden the update path. All of these are applied in subsequent fwupd releases.
Updating only the quirks file could result in flashing failures.

diff --git a/debian/patches/pixart-tp-Fix-a-comparison-of-narrow-type-with-wide-type.patch b/debian/patches/pixart-tp-Fix-a-comparison-of-narrow-type-with-wide-type.patch

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+From: Richard Hughes <richard@hughsie.com>
+Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:39:47 +0100
+Subject: pixart-tp: Fix a 'comparison of narrow type with wide type in loop
+ condition'
+
+Guard fu_pixart_tp_device_write_sector() against a chunk count that
+exceeds G_MAXUINT8, so the remaining guint8 loop counter cannot wrap
+and the write fails cleanly instead.
+
+Needed alongside the 4F01/4F02/4F0D/4F0E enablement, as the fault is
+only reachable once a write is attempted.
+
+(cherry picked from commit 35679d37b0dbe7d69ba3b163a090d9c38adf7f32)
+
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/fwupd/fwupd/commit/35679d37b
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Applied-Upstream: 2.1.3
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/fwupd/+bug/2169954
+---
+ plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c | 7 +++++++
+ 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+)
+
+diff --git a/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c b/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
+index a6a0e84..58321c1 100644
+--- a/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
++++ b/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
+@@ -990,6 +990,13 @@ fu_pixart_tp_device_write_sector(FuPixartTpDevice *self,
+ 
+ 	/* pages 1..15 */
+ 	chunks = fu_chunk_array_new_from_bytes(blob, 0x0, 0x0, FU_PIXART_TP_DEVICE_PAGE_SIZE);
++	if (fu_chunk_array_length(chunks) > G_MAXUINT8) {
++		g_set_error_literal(error,
++				    FWUPD_ERROR,
++				    FWUPD_ERROR_INVALID_FILE,
++				    "too many chunks in sector");
++		return FALSE;
++	}
+ 	for (guint8 i = 1; i < fu_chunk_array_length(chunks); i++) {
+ 		g_autoptr(FuChunk) chk = NULL;
+ 
diff --git a/debian/patches/pixart-tp-Fix-sector-index-truncation-to-guint8.patch b/debian/patches/pixart-tp-Fix-sector-index-truncation-to-guint8.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f046c4a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/pixart-tp-Fix-sector-index-truncation-to-guint8.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+From: Richard Hughes <richard@hughsie.com>
+Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 08:42:25 +0200
+Subject: pixart-tp: Fix sector index truncation to guint8 without range
+ validation
+
+The flash sector index was cast to guint8 without any range check, so a
+target flash offset beyond 256 sectors (1 MB at the 4096-byte sector
+size) silently wrapped and erased the wrong sector. The parameter is
+widened to guint and an explicit range check added.
+
+Needed alongside the 4F01/4F02/4F0D/4F0E enablement, as the fault is
+only reachable once a write is attempted.
+
+(cherry picked from commit 061b3481bafe846bc86737702b00f733b09712bc)
+
+Backport note: the upstream commit also touched
+plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-plp239-device.c, which does not exist in
+2.1.1 (added later by 2535bbfcd). Those hunks are dropped; only the
+fu-pixart-tp-device.c changes are applied.
+
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/fwupd/fwupd/commit/061b3481b
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Applied-Upstream: 2.1.2
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/fwupd/+bug/2169954
+---
+ plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c | 29 +++++++++++++++++++----------
+ 1 file changed, 19 insertions(+), 10 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c b/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
+index e7f63ab..a6a0e84 100644
+--- a/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
++++ b/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
+@@ -449,10 +449,21 @@ fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_wait_busy(FuPixartTpDevice *self, GError **error)
+ }
+ 
+ static gboolean
+-fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_erase_sector(FuPixartTpDevice *self, guint8 sector, GError **error)
++fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_erase_sector(FuPixartTpDevice *self, guint sector, GError **error)
+ {
+ 	guint32 flash_address = (guint32)sector * FU_PIXART_TP_DEVICE_SECTOR_SIZE;
+ 
++	/* sanity check */
++	if (sector > G_MAXUINT8) {
++		g_set_error(error,
++			    FWUPD_ERROR,
++			    FWUPD_ERROR_INVALID_DATA,
++			    "sector 0x%x exceeds maximum",
++			    sector);
++		return FALSE;
++	}
++
++	/* wait for flash ready and enable write */
+ 	if (!fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_wait_busy(self, error))
+ 		return FALSE;
+ 	if (!fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_write_enable(self, error))
+@@ -637,10 +648,10 @@ fu_pixart_tp_device_firmware_clear(FuPixartTpDevice *self,
+ 		return FALSE;
+ 	start_address = fu_pixart_tp_section_get_target_flash_start(section);
+ 	g_debug("clear firmware at start address 0x%08x", start_address);
+-	if (!fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_erase_sector(
+-		self,
+-		(guint8)(start_address / FU_PIXART_TP_DEVICE_SECTOR_SIZE),
+-		error)) {
++
++	if (!fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_erase_sector(self,
++						    start_address / FU_PIXART_TP_DEVICE_SECTOR_SIZE,
++						    error)) {
+ 		g_prefix_error_literal(error, "clear firmware failure: ");
+ 		return FALSE;
+ 	}
+@@ -1017,7 +1028,7 @@ fu_pixart_tp_device_write_section(FuPixartTpDevice *self,
+ {
+ 	FuPixartTpUpdateType update_type = FU_PIXART_TP_UPDATE_TYPE_GENERAL;
+ 	guint32 target_flash_start = fu_pixart_tp_section_get_target_flash_start(section);
+-	guint8 start_sector;
++	guint start_sector;
+ 	g_autoptr(FuChunkArray) chunks = NULL;
+ 	g_autoptr(GInputStream) stream = NULL;
+ 
+@@ -1067,11 +1078,9 @@ fu_pixart_tp_device_write_section(FuPixartTpDevice *self,
+ 		return FALSE;
+ 
+ 	/* erase phase */
+-	start_sector = (guint8)(target_flash_start / FU_PIXART_TP_DEVICE_SECTOR_SIZE);
++	start_sector = target_flash_start / FU_PIXART_TP_DEVICE_SECTOR_SIZE;
+ 	for (guint i = 0; i < fu_chunk_array_length(chunks); i++) {
+-		if (!fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_erase_sector(self,
+-							    (guint8)(start_sector + i),
+-							    error)) {
++		if (!fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_erase_sector(self, start_sector + i, error)) {
+ 			g_prefix_error(error, "failed to erase sector 0x%x: ", i);
+ 			return FALSE;
+ 		}
diff --git a/debian/patches/pixart-tp-Use-guint-for-chunk-iteration-to-avoid-wrap.patch b/debian/patches/pixart-tp-Use-guint-for-chunk-iteration-to-avoid-wrap.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b54fda7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/pixart-tp-Use-guint-for-chunk-iteration-to-avoid-wrap.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+From: Richard Hughes <richard@hughsie.com>
+Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 14:49:19 +0100
+Subject: pixart-tp: Use guint for chunk iteration to avoid wrap at 256
+
+The chunk loop counter in fu_pixart_tp_device_write_section() is a
+guint8, which wraps at 256 chunks. At the 256-byte page size that is a
+64 kB section, beyond which the erase phase iterates incorrectly.
+
+Needed alongside the 4F01/4F02/4F0D/4F0E enablement, as the fault is
+only reachable once a write is attempted.
+
+Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
+(cherry picked from commit dab8aa7820aa09fa53922630832a6c986ee1887c)
+
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/fwupd/fwupd/commit/dab8aa782
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Applied-Upstream: 2.1.2
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/fwupd/+bug/2169954
+---
+ plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c | 2 +-
+ 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)
+
+diff --git a/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c b/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
+index 2cd3893..e7f63ab 100644
+--- a/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
++++ b/plugins/pixart-tp/fu-pixart-tp-device.c
+@@ -1068,7 +1068,7 @@ fu_pixart_tp_device_write_section(FuPixartTpDevice *self,
+ 
+ 	/* erase phase */
+ 	start_sector = (guint8)(target_flash_start / FU_PIXART_TP_DEVICE_SECTOR_SIZE);
+-	for (guint8 i = 0; i < fu_chunk_array_length(chunks); i++) {
++	for (guint i = 0; i < fu_chunk_array_length(chunks); i++) {
+ 		if (!fu_pixart_tp_device_flash_erase_sector(self,
+ 							    (guint8)(start_sector + i),
+ 							    error)) {

 algoltek-usbcr-Restore-vendor-ID-check-in-probe-func.patch
